## About

- UC Davis B.S. Statistical Data Science with a Computer Science minor
- AI Search Strategist at XLR8 AI (San Francisco), working on how generative AI platforms discover, interpret, and recommend brands, and translating technical insights into client strategies (also framed as Generative Engine Optimization / GEO on the Experience section)
- Technical background in data science, machine learning, software development, data pipelines, analytical tools, and full-stack applications
- First-authored research on LLM agent autonomy, human oversight, and AI reliability (JAIKE)
- Interests: applied AI, data science, and building technical solutions for real-world problems

## Research

- First author, 30-page, 36-source review on LLM agent autonomy and human oversight, co-authored with Dr. Biren (Brian) Prasad (JAIKE). Introduces a two-axis autonomy/oversight framework and a cost model pricing oversight against productivity gains. Status: revise-and-resubmit, publication recommended. Not yet published.
- Peer reviewer for JAIKE (retrieval methods in LLMs, long-task reasoning, large-scale architectures)

## Featured projects

- [SF Restaurant Safety Map](https://github.com/royho1/sf-restaurant-safety-map): Full-stack map of 20,000+ health inspections across 7,700+ SF restaurants from the DataSF feed; Python ETL into SQLite, Flask REST API, React + Mapbox, Docker
- [Job Market Analytics Dashboard](https://github.com/royho1/job-market-analysis-dashboard): Group capstone; 23,000+ records deduplicated to 6,800+ unique postings from 2,300+ companies; Roy owned the JobSpy/Selenium scrapers and the TF-IDF resume matching engine
- [Drowsy Driver Detection](https://github.com/royho1/drowsy-driver-detection): Real-time drowsiness detection with dlib EAR and OpenCV; browser live demo on the site (Best Execution award)

## Additional projects

- [Solstice](https://www.royho-career.com/#projects): Sneaker resale analytics (photo ID, condition, market prices); Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript; in design and early build
- [Heart Stroke Risk Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/heart-stroke-risk-prediction): ML stroke-risk model with Streamlit app
- [Portuguese Wine Type and Quality Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/wine-quality-classification): R multivariate stats (logistic regression, LDA, MANOVA, PCA); 98.3% accuracy for red vs white classification
- [Stock Trading Algorithm](https://www.royho-career.com/#projects): Built at TechSprint Innovators; multi-factor screening with FinBERT NLP, supervised classification, and an automated daily ETL pipeline delivering real-time investment signals
- [NBA Player Performance Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/nba-player-prediction): Regression and classification on draft and historical stats
- [Analyzing Movie Reviews Across Genres](https://github.com/royho1/movie-reviews-analysis): IMDb audience vs critic reviews across five genres; RoBERTa sentiment vs VADER
- [Drake Time Series Analysis](https://github.com/royho1/drake-time-series-project): ARMA/ARIMA forecasts on 14 years of Google Trends data
- [NBA Player Salary Analysis](https://github.com/royho1/nba-salary-analysis): Linear regression on stats vs advanced metrics vs salary
- [Socioeconomic Predictors of Crime Rates](https://github.com/royho1/socioeconomic-predictors-of-crime-rates): Multiple linear regression and model selection
- [Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon](https://github.com/royho1/six-degrees-kevin-bacon): Graph BFS degrees of separation between actors
